control: Enterprise Google OAuth via Supabase Auth
summary: Google OAuth is implemented through Supabase Auth with a server-side /auth/google entrypoint and server-side /auth/callback code exchange. Redirect handling is restricted to localized dashboard paths, and the Google client secret is documented as server-only/provider-only. This evidence does not claim live production or preview provider execution because Google Cloud Console and Supabase runtime credentials are not available in this implementation environment.
redactionConfirmation: All secrets, tokens, credentials, authorization codes, session cookies, connection strings, and access-granting values are redacted.

requiredChecks: Production Google OAuth login completes through Supabase Auth and returns to https://<production-host>/auth/callback.
Preview Google OAuth login completes through Supabase Auth and returns to https://<preview-host>/auth/callback.
Google Authorized redirect URI equals the Supabase provider callback URL exactly.
Supabase Additional Redirect URLs include only exact application /auth/callback URLs or an approved controlled preview pattern.
Application logs do not contain OAuth code, access_token, refresh_token, id_token, set-cookie, cookie or Google client secret values.
providerProof.note: Run this validation in the target production and preview environments after Google Cloud Console and Supabase provider settings are configured. Keep raw screenshots and logs outside the repository.

environmentPlaceholders.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: server/provider secret store only; never NEXT_PUBLIC

acceptanceCriteria.enterpriseReleaseDecision: No-Go until live Google OAuth proof and live Supabase MFA or enterprise IdP step-up proof are attached
